justice: The roadway occupies most of the visible corridor, while dedicated pedestrian space is narrow and inconsistent along both sides, indicating limited balance in spatial allocation among users.

livability: The corridor includes trees, shrubs, and planted edges on both sides, which adds some environmental quality and softens the built setting.
